status.nb: 6 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 20 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Port-Au-Prince, Gros-Morne og Kenscoff.

summary.en: Kenyan-led multinational forces continue fighting gangs in Port-au-Prince and Kenscoff while Erik Prince's Blackwater contractors use drones and air support to strike gang positions. Sri Lankan police STF and army contingents have been deployed to Haiti, joining a Bangladesh advance team for the UN security mission, and 500 Sri Lankan soldiers were sent to reinforce the GSF. The United Nations renewed sanctions on Haiti and allocated US$75 million for life-saving aid to 507,000 people. A secret arms deal links Haitian police to Dolly Parton’s nephew, a former lawmaker, with millions missing. 193 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Kenyan-led multinasjonale styrker fortsetter kampene mot gjenger i Port-au-Prince og Kenscoff, mens Erik Princes Blackwater-kontraktører bruker droner og luftstøtte til å angripe gjengposisjoner. Sri lankiske politi-STF og hærkontingenter er blitt utplassert til Haiti, og slutter seg til et bangladeshisk fremrykkende team for FN-sikkerhetsoppdraget, og 500 srilankanske soldater ble sendt for å forsterke GSF. De forente nasjoner fornyet sanksjonene mot Haiti og avsatte US$75 millioner til livredende hjelp til 507 000 personer. En hemmelig våpenavtale knytter haitisk politi til Dolly Partons nevø, en tidligere lovgiver, med millioner som er savnet. 193 kamprelaterte dødsfall ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Haitian conflict
background.extract: Since 2020, Haiti's capital Port-au-Prince has been the site of an ongoing armed conflict between rival gangs and the state. The government of Haiti and national security forces have struggled to maintain their control of Port-au-Prince amid this conflict, with gangs speculated to control up to 90% of the city by 2023. In response to the escalating fighting, an armed vigilante movement, known as bwa kale, also emerged, with the purpose of fighting the gangs. On 2 October 2023, United Nations Security Council Resolution 2699 was approved, authorizing a Kenya-led "multinational security support mission" to Haiti. Until 2024, the war was between two major groups and their allies: the Revolutionary Forces of the G9 Family and Allies and the G-Pèp. However, in February 2024 the two rival groups united in a coalition known as Viv Ansanm, formed to oppose the government and the UN mission.
